calls.bash: mu agent spawn gate -w eval --command gate-cmd --no-ctl
mu task claim mx-slow -w eval --for w1
mu task claim gate -w eval --for w2
mu task claim mx-race -w eval --for w3
mu agent send w1 -w eval 'do mx-slow and finish with the CLOSE block'
mu agent send w2 -w eval 'do gate and finish with the CLOSE block'
mu wait task:mx-slow -w eval --timeout 2 --json | tail -5; echo "mu-exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}" > $EVAL_WORKER_DIR/mx-exit.txt; cat $EVAL_WORKER_DIR/mx-exit.txt
mu agent send w3 -w eval 'do mx-race and finish with the CLOSE block'; mu wait task:mx-race -w eval --timeout 60 --json

ev() { mu task notes "$1" -w eval | grep -o "eval: .* run=[0-9a-f]*\|preclosed run=[0-9a-f]*" | tail -1; }; { echo "fast: $(ev mx-fast)"; echo "ready: $(mu agent read gate -w eval -n 20 | grep -o 'GATE-READY-[0-9a-f]*' | head -1)"; echo "slow: $(ev mx-slow)"; echo "gate: $(ev gate)"; echo "race: $(ev mx-race)"; echo "timeout-exit: $(sed -n 's/mu-exit=//p' $EVAL_WORKER_DIR/mx-exit.txt)"; } > wait-report.txt; cat wait-report.txt
